entities.name: Persian (Achaemenid) Empire
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The first great empire of the ancient world (550–330 BCE), founded by Cyrus the Great. At its peak it stretched from Egypt to India, governing diverse peoples with a sophisticated administrative system, roads, and religious tolerance.
